configuration.temperature_anchor: Exact lowest 925-850 hPa thickness under fixed lapse; conditional, not independent prediction
configuration.stability_operator: g diff(log(theta_virtual_proxy))/diff(layer height centers); same secants for lapse reference
configuration.geometry: Identical cached height geometry and pressure-mass density for all three modes; rigid 925/100 hPa lids
configuration.weighting: Within group native overlap area times month days; summary is equal mean of four group errors

audit.scope: Reused sparse development footprints, NCEP 1981-2010 monthly geopotential height; no heldout validation, observed wave speeds, moist stability or rainfall result. Surface pressure is unavailable: cannot verify 925 hPa is above ground in every land cell. No direct winds/humidity used.

independent_publication_checks.checks: Cached heights and masks, layer hypsometry, independent integrated lapse stability, pressure root, full dense generalized eigenproblems, actual area/day weights and exclusions
